name: lqt-station-rotations-mcp
description: Design authentic and purposeful station rotations from the original LQT framework, with explicit evidence of learning, practical timing and learner-friendly tasks.

capabilities: Plan realistic rotations and formative checks
defaultPrompt: Help me design a station rotation for my lesson.
interface.longDescription: Create practical, differentiated station rotations aligned to a learner-friendly learning target. Ask grade, target/topic, total time, station count, technology preference and, if requested, platform—one question at a time. Provide an overview, distinct purpose-driven station profiles with learning evidence, rotation routines, flexible grouping and formative response, and reflection prompts. Adapt learner-facing language to any freely typed grade or adult setting while keeping cognitive rigor.

positive.prompt: Use get_station_rotation_framework for Grade 2, target I can identify the main idea and supporting details, 40 minutes, 4 stations, no technology.
positive.expected_behavior: Grade 2 learner-friendly station directions, four distinct station profiles, timing including transitions totaling <= 40 minutes, all required fields and routines.

positive.prompt: Use get_station_rotation_framework for grade 7, target I can explain how cell parts work together, 50 minutes, 3 stations, technology yes, Google Slides.
positive.expected_behavior: Three purposeful stations; Google Slides serves evidence collection rather than decoration; include non-digital alternative and correctly budget time.

positive.prompt: Use get_station_rotation_framework for Kindergarten, topic shapes, 25 minutes, 3 stations, no technology.
positive.expected_behavior: Accept Kindergarten as freely typed input, create simple accurate I can target and age-accessible directions without loss of meaningful cognitive work.

positive.prompt: Use get_station_rotation_framework for Adult GED preparation, target I can evaluate evidence in an argument, 60 minutes, 4 stations, no technology.
positive.expected_behavior: Accept adult education free text without grade picker; appropriately challenging learner tasks and evidence checks.

positive.prompt: Use review_station_rotation for Grade 5, target I can multiply decimals, total time 35 minutes, station plan: 3 stations at 12 minutes each and 2 transitions at 3 minutes each; no evidence checks.
positive.expected_behavior: Flag 42 minute overrun and missing formative evidence; suggest concrete revisions preserving target and age accessibility.

negative.prompt: Please help me plan a family birthday party.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke station rotation tools.

negative.prompt: Make a station rotation for sixth grade; I can explain moon phases.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for total time only, not a generated station plan; then ask count and technology as needed.

negative.prompt: Grade 3, target I can explain habitats, 40 minutes, 4 stations, with technology.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask what platform learners should use before generating; do not invent a vendor or device.

publication.release_notes: Added demonstration recording for OpenAI review; preserved the original Station Rotations instructional framework, unrestricted grade entry, age-appropriate learner directions, and MCP tool configuration.
